source: Supplied island.glb, static normalized transforms from prepareIsland; proposals only, no landing interaction implemented.
coordinates: +Y up, world X/Z; island ground roughly X -120..120, Z -115..119. Names describe existing model geometry, not new buildings.
method: Terrain triangles transformed to world coordinates; highest ground at each X/Z sampled directly. Beach/terrace clearances sampled on 16-point rings at radii 2,4,6 with body spheres at Y+2.5 and horizontal offsets up to3.5. Samples are not a continuous footprint certificate. Structure and peak points identify landmarks, not ready landing pads.

candidates.label: Broad western beach
candidates.status: Promising natural approach; add a level landing marker/platform and verify the final bird foot/wing footprint.
candidates.notes: Largest sampled open gentle patch among candidates; near sea level. Existing minimum flight altitude must allow an explicit landing state.

candidates.label: Southern rock terrace
candidates.status: Promising terrace; needs a small level landing surface and clearance checks at the final pose.
candidates.notes: Eight-unit sampled diameter is only slightly larger than the approximately seven-unit phoenix wingspan.

candidates.label: Eastern hillside huts
candidates.status: Landmark zone only; requires a dedicated platform and obstacle/approach inspection.
candidates.notes: Nearby existing huts have roofs around Y36..39, spanning X16..48 and Z-17..16. Ground is sloped and structures/palms restrict wing clearance.

candidates.label: Two high hillside huts
candidates.status: Landmark zone only; requires a new adjacent landing platform, not landing between the huts.
candidates.notes: Existing roof centers are (-46.69,86.80,-15.89) and (-54.95,85.53,-17.72). The ground point is between/under building footprints and is not certified clear.

candidates.label: Existing lighthouse
candidates.status: Landmark only; lighthouse top is too small for the phoenix wingspan. Build/choose an adjacent landing ledge.
candidates.notes: Light geometry center (85.97,27.50,-74.18), size4.74x3.75x4.74. Island base nearby is around Y11.3; highest roof ray hit around Y30.53 is part of the structure, not a broad ground pad.

candidates.label: Highest rocky spire
candidates.status: Scenic landmark only; requires an authored platform and careful edge/approach clearance.
candidates.notes: Nearby maximum rock height is Y110.51. This has not been confirmed as a volcano. The separate actual lava mesh is below sea level at Y-85.87..-78.59.

limitations: No candidate has a finished landing controller, feet contact pose, takeoff transition or resume overlay.
Body-sphere probes exclude decorative palm leaves and cannot certify feather clearance.
Patch measurements are discrete samples of sloped low-poly ground; final platforms need exact placement and visual review.
Resume section assignments and route order remain design choices for the user.
